items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Morris French, Kid Ory, Jack Keran, and let's see who else I can... Who was with Buddy Petit? Morris French was with Rene.

ctx.x: Who were some of the good trombone players down here when you were young?

Morris French, Kid Ory, Jack Keran, and let's see who else I can... Who was with Buddy Petit? Morris French was with Rene. I'm trying to... Oh, yeah, a little boy, George Washington. He never did come back. Little bit of fella. Played nice trombone.

items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: So somebody made me acquainted with Ori... And he asked me to come up and blow some. ... So I went up and blowed.

ctx.x: since you're both sick right now.

Well, about me and Louis, I'll tell you about that. Uh... I left the country in 1918, and I was 18 years old. I went to World War I, and when I came back, the first people I saw was playing at the 25, Louis Armstrong, Kid Ory, Johnny Dots, Baby Dots, and Bob Lyons on bass, and Lorenzo Starrs on guitar, so... You had to play in a drum?

items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: I sat in the band. ... In Kid Ora's band.

ctx.x: I sat in the band. Sitting in what band?
In Kid Ora's band. Oh, in Kid Ora's band.
